full_judgment: 5. Article 50 of the Order provides that the petitioner shall join as respondents to his election petition all contesting candidates, and any other candidate against whom any allegation, if any, of any corrupt or illegal practice is made and shall serve personally or by registered post on each such respondent a copy of his petition. In the present case the petitioner has impleaded the Returning Officer and Assistant Returning Officer as respondents in the Election petition in addition to others. It is submitted that they are unnecessary parties. Article 51 (2) provides that a petitioner may claim as relief any of the declarations, that the election of the returned candidate is void; and that the petitioner or some other person has been duly elected; or that the election as a whole is void. The learned Advocate contends that in the present election petition these two provisions of the Order has not been scrupulously followed which is mandatory. The learned Advocate has drawn our attention to the provision of Articles 58 Of the Order which provides that the Tribunal shall dismiss an election petition, if the provisions of Articles 50 of Articles 51 have not been complied with including clauss 4(c) of Articles 57, The second part of Article 58 is not applicable in this petition before us. It appears from the election petition that the petitioner has impleaded all the contesting candidates and in addition to that he has impleaded the Returning Officer and the Assistant Returning Officer and according to the learned Advocate this impleading of Returning Officer and Assistant Returning Officer is against the provision of Article 50 of the Order. When the petitioner has impleaded all the necessary parties mere impleading the Returning Officer and the Assistant Returning Officer or so to say misjoinder of these the petitioners cannot by itself be a ground for holding that there was total non compliance of the provision of Article 50 of the Order. Furthermore, in the election petition there are specific allegations of corrupt practice against these two officers. As regards the allegations of non compliance of Articles 81(2) of the Order we have gone through the prayer portion of the election petition and we find nothing wrong in it.
